fonts.display: 'Overused Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Sprat', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Void
palette.role: Page canvas, deepest surface, card backgrounds — the base layer against which everything else floats

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Section backgrounds, elevated panels, modal surfaces — first step off the canvas

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Card surfaces, nested containers, secondary panels

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Elevated surface fill, subtle button hover states, dark interactive variant

palette.name: Iron
palette.role: Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Muted helper text, inactive icons, low-emphasis body

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Secondary text, placeholder copy, subheadings, icon strokes

palette.name: Pearl
palette.role: Primary body text, card borders, heading borders — the dominant foreground voice

palette.name: Chalk
palette.role: Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Lavender Beam
palette.role: Link borders, accent strokes, chromatic highlight — the violet signal that breaks the monochrome

palette.name: Iris Glow
palette.role: Deeper violet for link hover, gradient endpoint, chromatic emphasis on interactive accents
